description: This file manages the model catalog in an OpenClaw system, including loading, caching, and querying model entries, as well as integrating provider plugins and handling model input types.

methods.name: loadModelSuppression
methods.description: Loads the model suppression runtime module, caching the promise.

methods.name: normalizeConfiguredModelInput
methods.description: Normalizes input configuration into a list of ModelInputType.

methods.name: readConfiguredOptInProviderModels
methods.description: Reads provider models from configuration and returns catalog entries.

methods.name: mergeConfiguredOptInProviderModels
methods.description: Merges configured provider models into the main model catalog.

methods.name: loadModelCatalog
methods.description: Asynchronously loads and caches the model catalog, including provider plugins and supplemental models.

methods.name: modelSupportsVision
methods.description: Checks if a model supports image input.

methods.name: modelSupportsDocument
methods.description: Checks if a model supports document/PDF input.

methods.name: findModelInCatalog
methods.description: Finds a model in the catalog by provider and model ID.
